messages.author: 6f5cc4e3ad8ddc79
messages.subject: Total model specification
parts:
Hello all,

I'm starting to use Lavaan to make a very simple model with structural equations: leadership (5 dimensions) as an antecedent of organizational climate (4 dimensiones) and psychological capital (4 dimensions) as a result of the latter. Each construct (leadership, climate and PsyCap is measured with an individual questionnaire, one for each). In the script, Pxx are the items in the questionnaires.

I am able to perform a confirmatory factor test (each construct separately), but I am unable to put them all together to make the total model. Among the constructs there is no covariation, only regression, but there is covariance between the dimensions of the same construct.

The following are the scripts of the models:

##CLIMATE
mod1<-' Apoyo=~ P31+ P32+ P33
Metas=~ P34+ P35+ P36
Innovacion=~ P37+ P38+ P39
Reglas=~ P310+ P311+ P312
Apoyo~~ Metas+ Innovacion+ Reglas
Metas~~ Innovacion+ Reglas
Innovacion~~ Reglas '

Clima <-  cfa(mod1, std.lv=F, data=Datos, estimator= "MLR")
summary(Clima,fit.measures=T,standardized=T)

With MLR: CFI=0,972; TLI=0,962; RMSEA=0,052; SRMR=0,035


##LEADERSHIP
mod2<-' Vision=~ P611+ P612+ P613
Cominspiracional=~ P614+ P615+ P616
Estintelectual=~ P617+ P618+ P619
Apoyolider=~ P6110+ P6111+ P6112
Reconpersonal=~ P6113+ P6114+ P6115
Vision~~ Cominspiracional+ Estintelectual+ Apoyolider+ Reconpersonal
Cominspiracional~~ Estintelectual+ Apoyolider+ Reconpersonal
Estintelectual~~ Apoyolider+ Reconpersonal
Apoyolider~~ Reconpersonal '

With MLR: CFI=0,958; TLI=0,945; RMSEA=0,075; SRMR=0,036


##PSYCAP
mod3<-' Eficacia=~ P1321+ P1322+ P1323
Confianza=~ P1324+ P1325+ P1326+ P1327
Resiliencia=~ P1328+ P1329+ P13210
Optimismo=~ P13211+ P13212
Eficacia~~ Confianza+ Resiliencia+ Optimismo
Confianza~~ Resiliencia+ Optimismo
Resiliencia~~ Optimismo '

With MLR: CFI=0,916; TLI=0,885; RMSEA=0,073; SRMR=0,070
With DWLS: CFI=0,988; TLI=0,984; RMSEA=0,037; SRMR=0,065 (best option)


##TOTALMODEL
?

How should I make the total model? I tried by entering the name of the variables used in the previous models, but R does not recognize them.

Best Regards,
Luis

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Total model specification
parts:
> How should I make the total model? I tried by entering the name of the
> variables used in the previous models, but R does not recognize them.

Just combining the previous pieces in a single model:

totalmodel <- '

Apoyo=~ P31+ P32+ P33
Metas=~ P34+ P35+ P36
Innovacion=~ P37+ P38+ P39
Reglas=~ P310+ P311+ P312

Vision=~ P611+ P612+ P613
Cominspiracional=~ P614+ P615+ P616
Estintelectual=~ P617+ P618+ P619
Apoyolider=~ P6110+ P6111+ P6112
Reconpersonal=~ P6113+ P6114+ P6115

Eficacia=~ P1321+ P1322+ P1323
Confianza=~ P1324+ P1325+ P1326+ P1327
Resiliencia=~ P1328+ P1329+ P13210
Optimismo=~ P13211+ P13212

'

This is just a CFA with all your constructs (and by default, all latent
variables are correlated). If you wish to add regressions, you simply
need to add them at the end of your syntax, eg,

Eficacia ~ Vision + Cominspiracional + Estintelectual + Apoyolider +
Reconpersonal

(or whatever makes sense for you).

Yves.
